pages: For the people...?
Demons are trying to take root in this country.
If this goes on, France will rot from the top down!
But the people living in Paris, and the farmers who grow our food...
They matter just as much...
Only when every citizen is happy
will the Queen truly be happy.
Everyone... happy?
That's right... everyone.
That is why I go to fight.
I understand, sister!
You're fighting to protect everyone in France!
Wow, that's amazing! For everyone!
Darn, if only I were a little bigger and stronger,
I could help you, sister...
Hehehe... What are you saying, Kardan?
It's because you'll protect the house as the eldest son of the Corday family
that I can go off to battle with peace of mind!
So I'll guard the house while you're away, sister!
That's right... Kardan.
You really are a good boy.
You're my pride and joy, little brother...
Sister, you're the one I'm proudest of!
There are lots of women who are just pretty,
but nobody else is as strong and beautiful as you!
Hehehe...
Maybe that's why no one will marry me.
...If only I were older,
I'd propose to you myself, sister!
...Merci... Kardan.
Well then, I'm off.
Take care of Father and Mother for me.
And be sure to listen to Belmont.
Yes, sister!
I'll be good, so come home soon!
If anything happens, send a letter with Pierre, as always!
Yes, sister!
Balman, take care of Kardan!
Woof... woof!
The people... look after the people... Listen to what they say...
Be a good lord...
Sister... I understand. For everyone...
So that everyone can be happy...
But... okay...
I'm off!
I'm glad Rimururu understood...
Once she sets her mind on something, she won't listen.
Now, I'd better hurry to the port of Kamuy.
Hmph! You're the one who won't listen once you've decided, sis!
Please, Shikuruu! Take me to the port of Kamuy!
I want to get there before sis! Please?
Pretty please! Come on, Shikuruu, we're friends, aren't we?
Oh, fine then!
See if I care! No more snacks for you!
And just so you know, I'm in charge of snacks while sis is away!
Please! I'm worried about sis...
She always works so hard for everyone,
but she never thinks about herself...
Come on, Shikuruu!
Yay! Shikuruu, I love you!
Thank you, Shikuruu!
I'll pay you back when I get home, so wait for me!
Okay then...
Sis shouldn't be here yet...
Umm... Teehee, nice weather today, huh?
You bet!
I can finally take my ship out, so I'm in a great mood!
You getting on the ship too, little lady?
You'll let me on?
If you've got a pass and money...
A pass and money...?
What... You've got no pass and no money?
Say, are you Nakoruru from Kamuy Kotan?
2026.question: Are you Nakoruru?

pages: We've been waiting for you! Let's set sail!
Wait, no, I'm not... Let go of me!
What are you talking about!
We held off sailing just to wait for you!
But then sis will...
Hey, listen to me!
No way! I don't want this!
Sis! Siiiis!
Was I just hearing things...
I thought I heard Rimururu's voice...
Heh, silly me.
I'm still worried about Rimururu after all...
She's not a child anymore. She wouldn't do anything reckless...
Is that... Rimururu?
The ship? The ship is... leaving?
Why? ...Wait!
Waaait!
And so Nakoruru's trip to Edo was greatly delayed.
The revived Amakusa ravaged Japan as he pleased,
and the Tokugawa shogunate perished in flames.
Japan fell into a demon realm ruled by terror...
Well then...
You're in the way of my work. Scram.
What work?!
All you do is stand around waiting for customers!
Hmph!
Oh... uh-oh...
Waaah, the ship's gonna leave at this rate...
What do I do!
Waaah... It's hopeless...
Young lady, crying won't help.
This is your last chance! Believe in yourself and go!
Believe in myself...
Okay, I'll try!
Konru! Lend me your strength!
Hiyaaah!
Bon voyage! I wish you a successful journey!
Whew, that was cramped!
I'd better hide before sis finds me...
Listen, your stowing away ends here...
Now! I have to find Lord Jubei's mansion...
Oh?
Is this the 'Samurai Tavern' Grandfather mentioned...?
Well, let's stop in for a bit.
I hope I can find some reliable companions here.
Excuse me... I'm a traveler...
Hm... Where am I...
You are awake, Lord Yagyu?
Mm...
Where... where is this place?
Kokain Temple, deep in Hida...
The Kokain of Master Nicotine Caffeine.
Hoh... So this is not the underworld after all...
Nor is it Izumo, then?
Was it Nicotine who moved me here from Izumo?
Or was it you?
We did so at Master Nicotine's request...
He said you would return, freed from the demon realm, to the fortress in Izumo,
and that we should go and fetch you.
Hmm... So Mizuki has been destroyed?
Yes, sir...
Heh heh... I see. It seems those young whelps pulled it off.
What has become of Edo?
It was destroyed by a monster called Ungo,
but thanks to Lord Hattori Hanzo the Shogun escaped,
and set up a temporary shogunate in Nikko.
The Shogun has now returned to Edo, and rebuilding progresses daily.
I see... Hanzo has had a hard time of it...
Still, it is a blessing it ended no worse.
At worst, every last soul in the land
might have been devoured by demons.
...No, first I must say all is well that ends well.
Indeed...
...Now it is the humans that worry me.
The Osaka loyalists still stirring about,
and the western lords... I fear they will make mischief...
Well, no matter. Given the circumstances,
a little rest now and then won't hurt...
Come to think of it, I'm hungry.
Might I have some rice porridge?
Right away...
How are you feeling now?
Thanks to you, I feel ten years younger!
Haha, my body moves like never before!
Is that so...
But you're not fully recovered yet,
so please don't overdo it.
Heh heh... My sword moves of its own accord.
Even I cannot stop it!
Hahahaha!
...Returning from the demon realm... What devilish luck you have...
I, the great Ongokuki, shall take your soul
and devour it once more!
...Kukukuku... Does it hurt? ...Are you afraid...?
Cry!
Wail!
The terrified screams of foolish humans
are the flesh and blood of us demons!
...Hey!
...Hey, I said hey!
...Jubei, are you even listening to me?
Heh heh heh... Perhaps I'm getting old...
I seem to be hearing things...
...Kukukuku
...I see, I see... So great is your fear
that you've lost your hearing...
Very well!
Gwahahahaha!
Surprised, Jubei?!
Cry!
Scream!
Tremble in fear!
I'll drink your blood
and offer it to revive Lord Ambrosia!
Hey! Jubei! Listen to me properly!
...I'm listening.
It seems you finally understand your situation...
That's right!
Now I shall devour your soul,
and with despair that tears your body apart and fear like a bottomless swamp,
you'll go back to the demon realm ruled by darkness!
Hahaha!
Kukuku... So afraid all you can do is laugh...
Isn't that right, Jubei...
Heh heh... You there, demon. Enough speeches, quite enough.
I'll play with you to pass the time,
so come on, have at me.
Grr... Such bravado...
Consider this mercy.
One instant!
In one instant I'll shatter your soul!
Take this, my strongest secret art!
Lord Ambrosia! Grant me ultimate power!
Ooooooooh!
Super Rending Demon Claw Fang Blast!
Thunder Blood Wind Formation!
Gyawawan!
Th-that's cruel! Gyaaah!
Lord Yagyu... You could leave the likes of this to us...
Hahahaha! It's fine, it's fine! A harmless demon like this...
Come, demon. Finished already? How pathetic...
Gr-grrr... Yagyu is still Yagyu, even rotten...
To think you had such a secret art...
I, Ongokuki, let my guard down.
You still don't understand. One like you cannot defeat me!
Huh?
I'm telling you to go catch a wild rabbit and eat that instead.
Kukuku... Laughable, laughable... Lost your nerve, Jubei?
The reason I, the great Ongokuki, came all the way from the demon realm...
To kill you and devour your soul. What else could it be?
I'd have liked another option...
This time I won't hold back! Take thiiiis!
Ultimate Super Rending Demon Claw Fang Fierce Blast Final Chapter!
Blazing Passion Kill Formation, Third Sword Fang, Starving Wolf Strangler...
Gwah!
My, my, what a melodramatic fellow.
Lord Yagyu, what shall we do with this one...
Say... why don't you just give up already?
Kukuku... Begging for your life now?
So the Yagyu sword has finally shown its true colors.
...My, my. I should have chosen better whom to show mercy.
Kukuku... Only embers of your life remain.
I hope it lasts until you reach Edo...
Tremble in fear!
With every step you take, your candle of life
grows shorter, inch by inch...
Ow!
J-Jubei! You! Watch where you're going!
Can't you even follow the rules of the road?!
Wh-what's this?! Y-you wanna fight?!
All right, bring it on! Behold! My ultimate secret art... Hm?
Wh-what? Humans...?
You'd be... Yagyu Jubei, right...
Hm... I am.
Word was you were dead,
but turns out you were alive all along...
Thing is, there's folks who don't do so well if you're alive...
...that's how it is, see.
Assassins hired by the Osaka faction?
Or Mori? ...Shimazu, perhaps?
Come on, that doesn't matter, you know that.
You've made enemies... of everybody.
Heh... Fair point.
Indeed, there are too many to count on both hands.
You're a smart one after all.
Then you get that it's about time you died, right?
Heh heh heh... Time for YOU to die!
Prepare yourself, Jubei!
Your life is mine!
Jubei belongs to me, the great Ongokuki...
Ow ow! What're you doing?! Hey!
Gwaaah!
Guoh!
Now then... Perhaps I'll ask your name.
You're not as good as the rumors say, Yagyu Jubei.
...Were you busy plucking nose hairs?
Heh heh heh... Then let your body test the truth of the rumors.
Kukuku... A small fry like you after Jubei's life?
Small as you are, I admire your spirit!
You've been noisy for a while now...
What're you supposed to be?
Here, he is no match for you.
Stand back, stand back!
Your soul, though not as fine as Jubei's,
looks rather tasty...
Be honored to be killed by the great Ongokuki!
Final secret art! Vacuum Rending Elemental Destruc...
Hmph... Filthy demon scum...
...There was no need to kill him.
Nonsense... The weak die.
Humans and demons alike.
The weak die... I see.
And now you die too!
Im... impossible... So fast...
...Needless killing debases the soul.
You think you hone your skill, but in truth you lower your worth as a man.
In the end, you may beat the weak, but never overcome the strong...
You can never surpass your limits and keep growing.
Not understanding that, you are a mere assassin,
and it was your fate to be cut down here.
Ugh... I regret...
Strangely, I couldn't hate that fellow.
Do demons have something like life, just as men do?
Perhaps devouring souls is, unexpectedly,
an expression of a wish to draw closer
to us who walk the true path of life.
...Thinking so, I pity him.
Might I ask one favor of you...
